points: Hot path is geometry_core::estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, called from PalletPoseNode::on_pair once per admitted detection (max_stage2 defaults to 2). Almost all of that time is two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 and, unless the free cost is already very low, two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior. PoseResult.tx/ty/tz and yaw_rad do not use the chamfer argmin: translation is the bbox-centre ray-plane hit mapped by R_dr/t_dr, and yaw is atan2 of the plane normal. best_pose is stored only in ChamferDebugV3_2 (theta, free/anchor/prior costs, confidence).

Default EstimatePoseParams make the free search a dense 3D grid: coarse theta/y/x is 21 x 31 x 31 = 20181 evaluations ( ±10 deg at 1 deg, ±0.15 m at 0.01 m) plus fine 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 ( ±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m), 28306 chamfer costs. The prior search adds coarse 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 ( ±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same ±10 deg) plus the same 8125 fine cells, 17386 more. prior_lambda 3.0 and lambda_floor 0.05 skip that second search only when confidence is high enough that free cost is about 6.23 mm or less; otherwise one detection pays about 45692 evaluations. OpenMP schedule(static) splits the flat index across threads and does not reduce the evaluation count.

The cached prototype is 182 double contour points (1.20 x 0.14 m outer plus two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets at contour_spacing_m 0.03). Rotation is reused per theta in thread-local ChamferTls, but chamfer_cost_from_rotated still value-copies that N x 2 buffer into tls.translated on every candidate, bilinear-samples all 182 points from the float distance image (four taps promoted to double), then copies the distances into a vector and std::sorts them for a 10% trimmed mean. Per candidate that is O(N log N) even though only the lowest 90% are summed.

sample_face_points walks the full depth frame before any plane work. camera.yaml is 640 x 480 depth and 1920 x 1080 RGB, so each detection does 307200 per-pixel K_inv multiplies, SE3 transforms, and pinhole projections, with cv::Mat::at bounds checks, then copies thread-local Eigen::Vector3d buckets into a MatrixXd one row at a time. build_bbox_mask first allocates and erodes a full 1920 x 1080 mask (erode_px 2) for a single rectangle.

ransac_plane_fit (default 100 iterations, early stop at 85% inliers) allocates a residual ArrayXd and a bool mask on every iteration, then compacts inliers into a new MatrixXd for JacobiSVD. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 computes plane_inlier_mask again and compacts plane_points_3d a second time. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates an extra N x 3 relative matrix plus the N x 2 result, and estimate_pca_long_axis allocates another centred copy of those 2D points.

The distance image is built once per detection but the grid is padding-dominated: resolution_m 0.005 and padding_m 0.80 turn a 1.20 x 0.14 m face into about 560 x 350 cells (~2e5 pixels). close_mask clones that mask, runs an elliptical close, then connectedComponentsWithStats; compute_distance_transform_v2 calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE and convertTo to CV_32FC1. OpenCV imgproc is the heavy one-shot dependency; Eigen dynamic MatrixXd is the copy/allocation dependency on the point path; OpenMP covers the depth scan and the chamfer grid; yaml-cpp runs only when the camera yaml is loaded.

depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth image into a new CV_32FC1 mat once per synced pair, before the detection loop. The prototype cache avoids rebuilding the 182-point contour, and ChamferTls avoids per-candidate heap growth, but those buffers are still fully recopied and sorted on every grid cell.
